newsitem.title: INDIA: India Sundram to meet for results May 8.
newsitem.headline: India Sundram to meet for results May 8.

text.p: India's Sundram Fastners, an auto ancillary-maker, will meet on May 8 to announce results for the year ending March 31, 1997, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday.
The company, based in the southern city of Madras, said the board of directors will also recommend dividend on equity shares at the meeting.
Shares of Sundram Fastners ended 14.25 rupees, or 2.8 percent lower at 610.75 at the Bombay exchange on Wednesday.
